observations.why: The imperative 'Forget' performs a self-originating directive to discard prior knowledge, appealing to the speaker's own authority over what is retained.
The directive to 'Remove all knowledge' enacts self-origination — the speaker determines what the system should and should not hold.
Asserting the observatory 'never calibrated it' appeals to the quality of craft — a claim about what calibration work was or was not done.
